lead.name: Professor Sheikh Tawhidul Islam
lead.role: Professor, RCSSTEAP at Beihang University, China; Senior Research Fellow, UNU-INWEH; Founding Director, Institute of Remote Sensing and GIS, Jahangirnagar University
lead.areas: Remote sensing, GIS, political ecology, climate change adaptation, disaster risk reduction, vulnerability analysis, and environmental development.
lead.bio: Professor Sheikh Tawhidul Islam works across remote sensing, GIS, climate change adaptation, disaster risk reduction, and environmental development. His supplied professional profile lists appointments with RCSSTEAP at Beihang University, UNU-INWEH, and Jahangirnagar University.

graduateResearchers.name: Puspendu Biswas Paul
graduateResearchers.areas: Satellite remote sensing, DEM evaluation, geospatial analysis, water resources, and flood screening.
graduateResearchers.bio: Puspendu Biswas Paul completed an MSc in Space Technology Applications at Beihang University and a BSc in Agricultural Engineering at Sylhet Agricultural University. His research includes satellite DEM benchmarking in Bangladesh and vertical-reference flood screening in the Ganges–Brahmaputra–Meghna delta.
